title: Spear Fia script-to-media links (links.json)
description: Which media file covers which words of the script. A link stores the quoted words and the line they were on; tools find the quote again when lines move, and report a link as lost when its words are gone.

id.description: Stable link ID (k1, k2, ...), never reused. Used as the cue_id of the clip a timeline plan places for it.

quote.description: The linked words, single-spaced, as they appear in the script (cues and formatting marks omitted)

line.description: Zero-based line in script.md where the quote was when linked; a hint, not an address

role.description: Role of the media folder the file came from

kind.description: picture: shown on screen; audio: heard (voiceover). Voiceover links are audio, the rest picture.

in.description: Source in point: HH:MM:SS, MM:SS or seconds (fractions allowed)

out.description: Source out point, same form as in

next_id.description: The number the next new link ID gets, so a deleted link's ID is never handed out again

$comment: TODO: word-level anchors once transcripts exist; whether a link can name a script cue ID.
